title: Moved our whole dev stack over
quote: We migrated our entire development infrastructure to StealthRDP and reduced our hosting costs by 40% while improving performance. The migration was seamless, and we've had zero downtime in 8 months.

title: My bots finally run somewhere permanent
quote: I used to keep my trading bots on a spare laptop that my kid would unplug. Now they sit on a machine that doesn't sleep, doesn't restart for updates, and doesn't live in my living room. Logged in, checked the latency, and I was done in an afternoon.

title: My office follows me now
quote: I travel a lot for client work and used to carry everything on a laptop that was always almost full. Now I just RDP in from whatever hotel wifi I'm on and my actual desktop is right there — same files, same shortcuts, same session. Feels like I never left.

title: Support talked to me like a person
quote: I asked a pre-sales question at like 11pm before ordering. Got a real answer in under an hour, not a canned 'please open a ticket' loop. That one interaction decided it — I ordered the Gold the same night.

title: Old software, new machine
quote: We run a legacy accounting package that barely works on anything modern. Having a Windows box I actually control — not a VM that resets itself — was the whole point. Set it up once, it's been running since March.

title: Scheduled jobs that actually run
quote: My previous host throttled background jobs so hard they'd timeout overnight. Here my cron jobs just run. I stopped checking the logs every morning after the first week — that's the real win, honestly.

title: Bandwidth is the real bandwidth
quote: We push a lot of data around for client dashboards and I've been burned by 'unlimited' plans that turn into a crawl by the 15th of the month. This one hasn't. Transferred 40GB in a night with zero drama.

title: I resell these to my clients
quote: I white-label VPS for a handful of agency clients who need simple hosting. The setup flow is quick enough that I don't dread onboarding a new one, and the client area is straightforward enough that they stop emailing me after a week.

title: Quietly reliable
quote: I'm not a server person — I run a small online store and I just want the thing to work. It does. Can't remember the last time I thought about hosting, which I think is the point.
